title: QA ledger fixes from the 2026-11-10 full run: eight stale steps or baselines, the smoke config's reused-server trap, four recurring fixtures, and 76 showcase author-time warnings
body:
qa#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AecbS6JEeLdRWSW4AC

Filing gate: ③ a task on the maintainer's word. Asked in session on 2026-11-10, after the full-platform test run listed its improvement suggestions, verbatim: 「立卡处理」.

QA-source: #32135 · checklist-accuracy notes and fixture gaps
Batch-of: objectstack-ai/objectstack#32135 follow-ups, 15 cards filed on the maintainer's 「立卡处理」

## What we saw

From the run record #32135 (checklist-accuracy section):
- platform-core.seed-integrity baseline says 132 rows / 19 datasets; the boot reads 138 / 20 and `showcase_invoice_line` authors 7 lines.
- identity-auth.session-list-revoke step 3: revoke takes `list-sessions`' `token`, not the `set-auth-token` bearer.
- integration-system.webhook-lifecycle: redeliver's key is `deliveryId`; secrets go in `signing_secret` / `headers_secret`; the column is `active`.
- api-backend.aggregate-contract-matrix: no null `annual_revenue` in the seed, so count-`*` vs count-field cannot discriminate.
- platform-core.console-login step 5 should name both an in-app navigation and a reload.
- records-forms.crud-roundtrip: `hq` is a location field; name a rule-free text field for the single-field edit.
- `examples/app-showcase/playwright.config.ts` reuses an existing server without `OS_TRUSTED_APP_SCHEMES`, so `mobile-signin-handoff.spec.ts` fails by construction on a reused boot.
- Four fixtures keep blocking high-value items: the contributor-bound member, a walled boot, a credentialed external database, a broken-upstream scratch app.
- The showcase boots with 76 author-time warnings (inert fields, approver nodes routing only to groups, an object with no resolvable title).

## Proposed change

Revise the named items (bump revision, add history), make the smoke spec skip with a reason when the reused server lacks the scheme, turn the four fixtures into one-command recipes, and bring the showcase's warnings to zero or to an explicit, reasoned allow-list.

## Business reason

Who: every QA runner and every agent that reads the showcase as the reference app. Cost: each run re-discovers the same stale steps, and a reference app with 76 warnings teaches that warnings are normal.

## Reader

Triage first touch; `docs/qa/platform-checklist` and `examples/app-showcase` (domain:devx).

## Duplicate check

`is:issue repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack showcase author-time warnings field-no-consumers` (11, open and closed): no card for these.
